title: ulmus glabra f. exoniensis
intro: Ulmus glabra f. exoniensis, commonly known as Wych Elm, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the family Ulmaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wych Elm involve its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in Wych Elm include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
